name: m3t5
description: Compressed-timescale village week (SPEC §2.3 / issue #50): four founding adults arrive beside two houses and a finished School on a 600-tick-day clock (adult 3d, elder 8d, lifespan 10d). NO commands are ever submitted. Day 1: the IAUS-fed village forms two households (housing + food surplus). Days 2-4: seeded daily birth rolls deliver four children (POP_ORIGIN_BIRTH) linked to both parents through digest-visible Household rows. Days 2-4: the children attend 9am-3pm lessons under the level-2 gathering teacher, accruing knowledge XP and attendance credit. Day 5: the founders cross into elder light duty AND the first schooled children graduate at the exact adult boundary, rolling guaranteed bonus traits. Day 7: the founding cohort dies of old age together (lifespan). Day 8: the bereft second generation's household rows are gone, so siblings-turned-adults re-marry into a third household. Days 9-11: third-generation births. Fixture pins milestone digests every 300th tick, the sampled lifecycle arc (stages/population/event counters at day boundaries), semantic gates (births, graduations, deaths, child-skip evidence, measurable graduate knowledge), and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
